meta.name: Something Is Killing the Children
meta.description: In the sleepy town of Archer’s Peak, children are dying in inexplicable, horrific ways. Those who remain share stories of terrifying creatures that lurk in the shadows, eager to tear children limb from limb. The local authorities refuse to believe these impossible “ghost stories.” Until a mysterious woman who talks to her stuffed octopus arrives in town. Her name is Erica Slaughter and she kills monsters.
